description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat
